items.q: How does Shopee Shopping Operations work with Amazon/Shopee?
items.a: We integrate with 20+ e-commerce platforms including Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and AliExpress. Every task on Shopee Shopping Operations corresponds to a real product listing. You promote the product — when a sale happens, you earn the margin. The platform and brand handle fulfillment and support.

items.q: Do I need to buy inventory?
items.a: Absolutely not. We operate on a zero-inventory model. Products ship directly from platforms and brands. You never touch inventory — just pick tasks and share links.
100% free. Registration, tasks, and promotion all cost nothing. We only take a small platform fee from successful transactions — you only share when you earn.

Three ways: 1) Pick e-commerce tasks — promote Amazon/Shopee products and earn the price margin; 2) Complete daily check-ins and bonus tasks for points; 3) Invite friends and earn team commissions up to 3 tiers.

items.q: How much can I earn per sale?
items.a: Varies by product. Electronics: $5-50 per sale. Home goods: $3-15. Beauty: $2-10. Our cost is 85% of market price — you keep the 15% margin on every order.
Once the order is confirmed delivered (typically 3-7 days), your profit lands in your wallet instantly. Cash out anytime.
Go to 'My Account' → 'Wallet' → 'Withdraw'. We support bank transfers and digital wallets. Minimum withdrawal is $10, typically processed in 1-3 business days.
Regular users pay 1%. VIP members enjoy fee-free withdrawals.
Go to the Tasks page, tap 'Invite Friends'. Share your referral link or QR code. You earn a percentage of their earnings up to 3 tiers deep.

items.q: Is there a limit on invitations?
items.a: No limit. More invites = more team earnings.
Android app and web (H5) currently available. iOS version is in development.
Bank-grade encryption. Immutable transaction records. We will never sell or compromise your personal information.
